feature: Optional bounded GNSS recovery after innovation rejection
qualification_scope: 64 guarded/confirmation positives and four declared expiry controls; 24 no-guard comparisons retain their measured failures and are not qualified positives.
platform: Linux x86_64; other configured CI platforms not observed locally

design.mechanism: Optional bounded current-pose GNSS recovery proposal and three-new-acquisition confirmation after existing two-innovation-rejection hold. Pending/out-of-bound proposals roll back complete filter/history and only record original-observation rejection diagnostics. Expiry stays latched until external pipeline reinitialization.
design.base_fixtures: Previous GNSS covariance scenarios unchanged, except explicit operational gnss_recovery calibration. Paired controls remove only this option. Map-bias worlds compose original map scenarios with the same 0.8m narrow-axis bias at [8,11). Expiry controls use [8,18) and require stationary braking beyond expiry and after healthy signals return.
design.retention: Keep every first outcome. Do not alter frozen physical criteria after execution. Separate proposal bounds from uncertainty calibration; no truth inputs or general bias-detection claim.
design.measured_motion: Missing, stale or invalid measured motion during an active hold expires recovery; no confirmation from an uncovered dead-reckoning interval.

required_check.storage_policy: Retain every current raw byte in immutable verified archives and every historical byte in original immutable backups. Do not restore duplicate mutable live outputs in this constrained workspace.

validation.first_required_check: Clippy found two needless test-only borrows; the repair is the sole Rust/auditor change after physical trials. Both final runtime binaries are byte-identical to frozen candidates.
